findings.evidence: Lines 315-322, 336-339, 342-346. Non-terminal `simp` is exactly the short-but-brittle pattern: `nPlus_nPlus`/`nMinus_nMinus` (313-314) close with plain `simp` because the η-terms cancel, while `nPlus_nMinus` needs `√2 * √2 = 2` — that extra fact is supplied by whatever `field_simp` and `norm_num` happen to find, and is nowhere named.
findings.fix: Replace the leading `simp [...]` with `simp only [...]` listing the lemmas actually needed (`Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_basis_left`/`_right`, `minkowskiMatrix.inl_0_inl_0`, `minkowskiMatrix.inr_i_inr_i`, `map_add`, `map_smul`), so the intermediate goal is pinned, and close with a single terminal step (e.g. `field_simp [Real.mul_self_sqrt]` or `rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)]; ring`).
findings.issue: Four proofs chain automation after a non-terminal `simp`: `nPlus_nMinus` (316-318) and `nMinus_nPlus` (320-322) are `simp [...]; field_simp; norm_num`, and `minkowskiAxis_plus` (338-339) / `minkowskiAxis_minus` (345-346) are `simp [...]; ring`. The goal handed to `field_simp`/`ring` is invisible and shifts silently when the default simp set moves, so all four break together on an upstream change.

findings.evidence: Lines 311-346; the six proofs share a single computation that is currently inlined, so a change in the Physlib `minkowskiProduct_basis_left`/`_right` simp lemmas requires repairing six scripts rather than one.
findings.fix: Extract one reusable lemma before `minkowskiAxis`, e.g. `minkowskiProduct (basis (Sum.inl 0) + s • basis (Sum.inr i)) (basis (Sum.inl 0) + t • basis (Sum.inr i)) = 1 - s * t` (and a one-sided version for the component lemmas), then discharge all four structure fields and both `_plus`/`_minus` lemmas from it.
findings.issue: The same Minkowski product of `(√2)⁻¹ • (e₀ ± eᵢ)` is recomputed six times with near-identical scripts: lines 313, 314, 315-318, 319-322, 337-339, 344-346. `nPlus_nPlus`/`nMinus_nMinus` are character-identical, as are `nPlus_nMinus`/`nMinus_nPlus`; `minkowskiAxis_plus`/`_minus` differ only in sign.

summary: The abstract CommRing/Field sections are clean and robust, but every proof in the Minkowski section ends automation after a non-terminal `simp`, and the same √2 computation is re-run six times instead of being factored into one lemma.
